root_idea.summary: The root centers on mixing, interpenetration, and close contact: a garment comes into contact with and envelops its wearer, while an affair may become mixed and unclear.
root_idea.development: From the basic act of wearing or being closely enveloped, the lexical field extends to confusing or concealing a matter, covering, intimate association, involvement, and entanglement.

senses.definition: To put on or wear clothing, armor, or another covering.
senses.usage_conditions: Used transitively for assuming or wearing an item; Quranic occurrences include clothing and garments worn by people.

senses.definition: To mix, confuse, obscure, or make a matter doubtful.
senses.usage_conditions: Used in constructions involving a matter, truth, belief, or circumstance being mixed with something else or rendered unclear; it may also describe causing people to be confused or divided.

senses.definition: Confusion, obscurity, or doubt in a matter.
senses.usage_conditions: A noun describing lack of clarity or the dubiousness of an affair.

senses.definition: A coat of mail or suit of armor.
senses.usage_conditions: In the Quranic expression concerning what was made for David, the word denotes protective armor rather than clothing in general.

senses.definition: Clothing, dress, apparel, or whatever is worn.
senses.usage_conditions: The literal sense covers garments and other things worn on the body.

senses.definition: A covering or enveloping veil; figuratively, something that conceals.
senses.usage_conditions: In the Quran, night is described as a covering because its darkness envelops and conceals.

senses.definition: A garment metaphorically applied to each spouse as the other's close covering and intimate companion.
senses.usage_conditions: Used in the reciprocal construction in which husband and wife are each called a garment for the other.

senses.definition: A figurative garment of piety: modesty, moral restraint, righteous conduct, or faith.
senses.usage_conditions: Used in the expression لِبَاسُ التَّقْوَى; the lexical image is a protective and morally covering garment, with several closely related interpretive renderings.

senses.definition: An all-enveloping condition, specifically the extremity of hunger and fear.
senses.usage_conditions: Used figuratively in the expression لِبَاسَ الْجُوعِ وَالْخَوْفِ, presenting hunger and fear as conditions that surround and overtake a people.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To assume pudency as though it were a garment, thereby protecting oneself through modesty.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Figurative usage.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To feign inattention or heedlessness toward someone or something.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Used in expressions involving pretending to be deaf or inattentive.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To live with, associate with, choose as a companion, or tolerate someone over time.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A figurative extension describing sustained companionship or consorting, including association despite a person's faults.

other_classical_meanings.definition: The intensive causing of confusion or doubt, including concealment, disguise, or cloaking of a matter.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A verbal noun associated with Form II; it may describe deliberate involvement of a matter in confusion.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To mix or consort closely with someone and thereby become acquainted with the person's inward state.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The related noun مُلَابَسَةٌ can denote close or intimate connection and social intercourse.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To put a garment on someone; to clothe or adorn someone with an item.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Causative usage with a person as the recipient of clothing or covering.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To cover or overspread something; of land, to become covered by plants or herbage.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The covering may extend over the whole of the object or surface.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To clad oneself or put on a garment.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Used with بِـ or with a garment as the object.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To occupy, engage, or involve oneself in an affair or activity.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The affair may be described as something with which one becomes mixed or entangled.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To cling to, adhere to, or become mingled with something.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Used of food adhering to a hand or of an affair or feeling mingling with and clinging to a person.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To become entangled, as spun thread.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Literal usage describing threads or similar material becoming tangled.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To become involved, complicated, confused, or doubtful.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Used of a thing, affair, or case becoming unclear, or of a matter becoming confused to someone.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To overtake someone, specifically said of horsemen overtaking him.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: An idiomatic tropical usage.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To have something as an accompaniment, adjunct, or concomitant.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Used with بِـ for an accompanying attribute or circumstance.

other_classical_meanings.definition: The confused onset of darkness or the beginning of night.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A specialized noun usage referring to darkness becoming confused or indistinct.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A man possessing clothing, dress, or apparel.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A possessive epithet.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A single act or occasion of putting on or wearing a garment.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Can specify that a garment was worn once.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A mode or manner of dressing, or a particular type of garment or cloth.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: May refer to the style of attire appropriate to a time or circumstance.

other_classical_meanings.definition: The cloth covering of the Kaaba or of a camel litter.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A conventional possessive construction for a covering made of cloth.

other_classical_meanings.definition: The pericranium, the membranous layer between the skin and flesh over a bone.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: An anatomical usage, especially in the expression لِبْسُ الْعَظْمِ.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Anything worn, including clothing and protective equipment.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A broader nominal usage than the Quranic specialized reference to a coat of mail.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A weapon.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A masculine usage distinct from the feminine usage for a coat of mail.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Much-worn, used, or worn-out.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Applied to garments, leather water-bags, ropes, houses, and similar things according to the relevant comparison.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A like, equal, or counterpart.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Used in the expression لَيْسَ لَهُ لَبِيسٌ, meaning that someone or something has no equal.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A person who has or wears many clothes.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: An intensive personal epithet.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A person who frequently confuses or confounds matters.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: An intensive epithet; the lexical evidence distinguishes it from the vulgar form مُلَبِّسٌ for this meaning.

other_classical_meanings.definition: One who feigns inattention or heedlessness.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Used in the expression لَابِسًا أُذُنَيْهِ.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Profit, benefit, or something enjoyable obtained from a person.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Used in the expression مَا فِي فُلَانٍ مَلْبَسٌ, literally asking whether there is anything to be enjoyed or gained in someone.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Pride or greatness in a person.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Used in the expression إِنَّ فِيهِ لَمَلْبَسًا according to the cited explanation.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Confounded, confused, or doubtful.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: An adjective applied to an affair, thing, or case that lacks clarity.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Sugared almonds and similar confectionery.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A specialized lexical usage with the plural مُلَبَّسَات.

cautions: The Form I QAC group contains both the wear/put-on branch and the confuse/mix branch; their assignment depends on the Quranic construction and lexical context, not on the undifferentiated internal QAC lemma alone.

The figurative expression لِبَاسُ التَّقْوَى has a closely related interpretive range including modesty, moral restraint, righteous conduct, and faith; these are retained as one figurative garment sense rather than separate lexical entries.
